Grace has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. In fact, technology changes society quickly.

The e-book shelf looked quieter than usual that evening. People around Grace often share different ideas about the e-book shelf. At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. The film reflects societal changes of the sixties.

On Monday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. Little by little, things began to change. Grace will take part in a basketball match in December. The automobile industry is changing quickly with electric cars.

The message box has become an important part of daily life. Leo advised Grace to try dancing as a new hobby. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Also, he left his corporate job to start a small bakery.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
